features.title: Render a "hostile" title with `backticks` & ampersands
features.intent:
Feeding the renderer text full of "quotes" & {{lowercase braces}}
across two lines must still parse in every structured file.
features.serves: REQ-AC1: pyproject.toml parses with the hostile description "as-is" (escaped)
acceptance: Rendered pyproject.toml parses and contains the hostile description escaped, not altered.

features.title: Carry newlines & 'single quotes' into Markdown verbatim
features.intent:
Markdown docs carry quotes, `backticks`, {{braces}} and newlines
verbatim -- no sanitizing, no prettifying.
features.serves: REQ-AC3: Markdown docs carry hostile text verbatim
acceptance: A rendered Markdown doc contains the hostile project fields byte-for-byte, including embedded newlines.
